label: 115th Congress (2017–2019)
text:
Across the 115th Congress we entered 74,668 statements into the record. What we returned to, together, was one program. On 2017-09-05, 158 of us said "deferred action for"; 156 said "deferred action for childhood"; 153 said "deferred action for childhood arrivals." The article-led forms tracked close behind — 142 of us said "the deferred action," 138 "the deferred action for," 135 "the deferred action for childhood arrivals." On the same peak day 135 of us said "childhood arrivals daca."

We did not originate the phrase. The record shows it was first said on 2013-02-13, by Chuck Grassley, who was not one of us. We adopted it. Four years later, on a single day, more than 150 of us were saying the same seven words. The instrument notes the convergence without accounting for it. That is what the record from this era holds.
